votes.evidence_summary: HTTP 200 responses accepting wrong types for multiple field types: string to Int64, int to VarChar, string to Bool
votes.rationale: Log shows REST API accepting type mismatches with implicit coercion: int64_f='123' (string to Int64), varchar_f=123 (int to VarChar), bool_f='true' (string to Bool), all with code=0; API performs unsafe implicit type coercion instead of rejecting type mismatches, violating type safety constraints for Int64/VarChar/Bool fields
